note: Shot list for the True Convo story site. Atmosphere only: no people, no faces, no text, no logos, no screens. Prices are entered by hand from the model's fal page and checked again before any run.

model.why: Wan is open-weight, so the same kind of clip could later be made for free on a local machine.

style: Slow, calm, locked-off camera. Warm Ember palette: deep brown-black shadows, magenta and coral light, amber highlights. Soft film grain. No people, no text, no logos, no screens with content.

shots.use: One cheap test so we see the quality before spending more.
shots.prompt: A window at first light, sky turning from deep magenta to coral above low rolling hills, thin mist in the valley, very slow movement.

shots.use: Behind the title on every person's page, before the sun rises.
shots.prompt: Wide view of low rolling hills before sunrise, a band of coral and amber light growing on the horizon, mist drifting slowly through the valley, stars fading in a deep magenta sky.
Soft midday light falling across a plain wooden table by an open window, leaf shadows moving gently on the surface, a cup of tea steaming, warm and quiet.

shots.use: Behind the evening scene, phone to Mac.
shots.prompt: A quiet street of small houses at dusk, windows lighting up one by one in warm amber, sky fading from coral to deep magenta, very slow.

shots.use: Behind the house scene with the wall screen.
shots.prompt: Inside a calm home at night, warm lamp light in an empty room, rain softly on the window, city lights blurred far outside, almost still.
